description: This file defines the class `TemplateFloat`, which extends `TemplateRange` to implement a floating-point number field type for SuiteCRM. It specifies properties like length and precision, and includes methods for retrieving field definitions and database types.

classes.name: TemplateFloat
classes.description: A class extending `TemplateRange` to implement float field with specific length and precision.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new `TemplateFloat` object, setting up inheritance and mapping the 'precision' property.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array including the precision value, either from `ext1` or the default `precision`.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Returns the database column type string for the float with specified length and precision.
